names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 3 марта ст. ст., name page 13692, «Михаил (Строев), мч.», with the grade and rank words left off; the day’s own line declines the forename and gives no surname at all. The surname in brackets is part of the name the calendar’s link gives and is kept. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, `.tmp/rusurn.py` finds the surname on no folder at all, and the bare «Михаил» is held by twelve.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 марта ст. ст. — «Прмц. Марфы и мч. Михаила (1938).»

attestations.note: The line names two people of 1938 and this folder is one of them; nothing on either host makes them a company, and no relation between them is recorded. azbyka.ru keeps him, besides 16 марта, on three moveable synaxes — of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church, of the saints of Kuzbass and of the saints of Moscow — and not one of them is a fixed day or an offset from Pascha this corpus can hold; all three are named in the life instead.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's list for 16 martie, the corresponding civil day (6 October 2026).
Not checked: saint.gr's list for 16 Μαρτίου, the corresponding civil day (6 October 2026).
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for 16 March 2026 (6 October 2026).

birth.note: azbyka.ru: «Мученик Михаил родился 6 сентября 1876 года в городе Воскресенске Звенигородского уезда Московской губернии в семье Степана Строева — бывшего крепостного живописца, приписанного к Новоиерусалимскому монастырю»

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line of the two for 3 марта ст. ст. with «(1938)», and azbyka.ru has him die in confinement in the Суслово section of Сиблаг on 16 March 1938, which is that Julian 3 March by the civil reckoning. He was sentenced on 27 November 1937 to ten years and not to death, so the year is the year he died in the camp and not a year of execution; no day is recorded here because this corpus records years.
